optimizedDescription.value: Provides two smart-caveman optimizer agents, capability fallback, strict effective-config gate, and distinct spec/project persistence routes.

optimizedContext.value:
# Optimizer Agents

## Rules
- Provide `specd-project-context-optimizer` (project context) and `specd-spec-context-optimizer` (spec rules/constraints/scenarios); do not publish `specd-metadata` skill.
- Generated content: smart caveman—drop articles/filler, terse fragments; preserve symbols/APIs/values/constants; headings `## Rules`, `## Constraints`; target 50–70% token reduction without normative loss.
- `SPECD-AGENT.md.tpl` is raw prompt only, no YAML/metadata; associated `specd-agent.meta.json` owns metadata.
- Runtime lacking `agents`: copy agent template alongside `shared.md` for manual/inline orchestrator use.
- Before any work run `specd project status --format toon`; inspect top-level effective `llmOptimizedContext`. Anything except exactly `true` → exit; generate/persist nothing. Never use `specs metadata` as gate.
- Spec optimizer persists only via `specs optimizations set <spec-id> --optimized-description <text> --optimized-context <text>`; may omit field, may combine direct flags, never combine with `--input`. Never metadata-edit spec optimizations or run `specs generate-metadata` after.
- Project optimizer persists only via `project update-metadata --optimized-context <text>`; never spec-scoped optimization command.

## Constraints
- Gate is effective config; consumers self-heal materialized metadata.
